blocks.text: Do coils ek doosre ke close (qareeb) rakhi hain (Fig. 17.20). Jo coil switch S aur rheostat ke zariye battery se juri hai use primary coil kehte hain; jo galvanometer se juri hai woh secondary coil hai. Rheostat ki resistance badal kar primary ka current badlen to surrounding region (aas paas) ka magnetic flux badalta hai. Secondary coil primary ke magnetic field mein hai, is liye badalta flux secondary se bhi guzarta hai aur secondary mein emf induce (paida) hoti hai.

blocks.title: Mutual induction
blocks.text: Jab ek coil ka badalta current doosri coil mein emf paida kare, to is phenomenon (amal) ko mutual induction kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Primary coil, jo switch aur battery ke zariye rheostat se juri hai (current Ip), secondary coil ke saath sire se sira rakhi hai jo galvanometer se juri hai (current Is). Magnetic field lines primary se secondary mein guzarti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.20: Do coils ke darmiyan mutual induction maloom karne ka circuit (kitab ki Figure 17.20 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Primary ka current badalne par us ka magnetic field badalta hai; yeh field secondary se bhi guzarta hai, is liye secondary mein emf paida hoti hai aur galvanometer ki needle (sui) hilti hai. Current steady (mustaqil) ho to field nahi badalta aur galvanometer zero par rehta hai.

Yahan Nₛ secondary coil ke turns (chakkar) ki number (tadaad) hai.
Secondary ke ek loop se flux φₛ ho to Nₛ loops se net (kul) flux Nₛφₛ hai. Yeh primary ke current Iₚ ke magnetic field ke proportional hai, aur woh field khud Iₚ ke proportional hai, is liye:

Mutual inductance M in factors par depend (munhasir) karti hai:

items: Primary aur secondary dono coils ke turns ki number.
Dono coils ke cross-section ka area.
Coils ke darmiyan medium ki magnetic permeability.
Jis material par coils lapeti gayi hain us ki nature (qism).
Primary aur secondary coils ki orientation (rukh).

blocks.text: Faraday's law se secondary mein emf, secondary ke flux ke rate of change se milti hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is line mein Nₛ ki jagah sirf N likhti hai; yeh Nₛ hai, yani secondary coil ke turns (Eq. 17.39 ki tarah): εₛ = −Nₛ Δφₛ/Δt.

Yani secondary mein induced emf primary ke current ke rate of change ke proportional hai. Minus ka sign (nishan) batata hai ke induced emf aisi direction (simt) mein hai jo primary ke current ke change ko oppose (mukhalfat) kare (Lenz's law). Mutual inductance M ki magnitude (miqdar):

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Eq. (17.42) mein emf ko Eₛ likhti hai; yeh secondary ki induced emf εₛ (us ki magnitude) hai: M = εₛ/(ΔIₚ/Δt).

blocks.title: Mutual inductance
blocks.text: Secondary mein induced average emf aur primary ke current ke rate of change ka ratio (nisbat) mutual inductance hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is definition ko 'Mutual induction can be defined as ratio ...' likhti hai. Ratio mutual inductance M hai; mutual induction to phenomenon (amal) ka naam hai.

M ki SI unit V s A⁻¹ hai, jise Joseph Henry ke naam par henry kehte hain. Do coils ki mutual inductance 1 henry hai agar primary mein current 1 ampere per second ke rate se badle aur secondary mein 1 volt emf paida ho.

Mutual inductance bohat se devices (aalaat) mein kaam aati hai: transformer, electric motor, generator waghera. Digital signal processing mein bhi is ka bara role (kirdar) hai, aur pacemaker aur metal detector jaise devices mein bhi use hoti hai.

blocks.title: Brain teaser
blocks.text: Kya aap jante hain pacemaker kaise kaam karta hai? (Neeche tasveer: seene mein skin (jild) ke neeche pacemaker, aur us ki wires, yani pacemaker leads (taarein), dil ke right atrium aur right ventricle tak.)

blocks.alt: Seena aur dil. Pacemaker seene ke oopar wale hisse mein skin (jild) ke neeche hai (tasveer ke daen taraf). Us ki pacemaker leads (taarein) aik bari vein (nas) se guzar kar dil ke right atrium aur right ventricle tak jati hain (tasveer ke baen taraf).
blocks.caption: Brain teaser: pacemaker aur us ki leads, right atrium aur right ventricle mein (kitab ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.prompt: Brain teaser ka jawab: pacemaker kaise kaam karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Pacemaker ek chhota battery wala device hai jo seene mein skin ke neeche rakha jata hai; us ki wires (leads) dil ke right atrium aur right ventricle tak jati hain. Yeh dil ke apne electric signals sense (mehsoos) karta hai, aur jab dil bohat aahista ya irregular (be-qaida) dhadke to chhote electric pulses bhejta hai jo dil ke muscles ko theek speed se contract (sukarne) par majboor karte hain.

blocks.title: Izafi misal (kitab mein nahi)
blocks.problem: Do coils ki mutual inductance 0.2 H hai. Primary ka current 50 A s⁻¹ ke rate se badal raha hai. Secondary mein paida emf nikalein.
steps: εₛ = −M ΔIₚ/Δt (magnitude ke liye minus chhor dein)
blocks.answer: εₛ = 10 V (aisi direction mein jo change ko oppose kare)

blocks.prompt: Primary mein steady current ho to secondary mein emf kyun nahi aati?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke emf primary ke current ke rate of change par depend karti hai (εₛ = −M ΔIₚ/Δt). Steady current ka flux nahi badalta, is liye ΔIₚ/Δt = 0 aur koi emf paida nahi hoti.

items: Mutual induction: primary ka badalta current secondary mein emf paida karta hai.
Nₛφₛ = MIₚ; εₛ = −M ΔIₚ/Δt; unit henry.
M turns, area, permeability, core ke material, distance aur orientation par depend karti hai; uses: transformer, motor, generator, metal detector.
